caption:
Meta just leveled up its smart glasses lineup. Ray-Ban Meta Audio (its first audio-only pair), a slimmer Gen 3 with a 12MP camera, and Muse — a hands-free personal AI agent. All powered by Meta AI.

Save this for the full breakdown of prices, specs and rollout.

#meta #metaai #rayban #smartglasses #ai #wearabletech #aitools

slides.title: Meta's smart glasses just leveled up.
slides.sub: Ray-Ban Meta Audio, a slimmer Gen 3, and Muse — all running Meta AI.
slides.voiceover: Meta just launched a whole new lineup of AI glasses at Connect.

slides.label: What launched
slides.title: Three new products, one event
items: Capri, Nova + Kylie Jenner and LISA editions
slides.voiceover: Three new products: audio-only glasses, a slimmer Gen 3, and Muse.

slides.label: Pick your pair
slides.title: Audio vs. Gen 3
slides.voiceover: The Audio glasses skip the camera; Gen 3 adds a 12 megapixel camera and 3K video.

slides.label: Meta AI on your face
slides.title: What the assistant does
items: Ask Meta AI without touching your phone
Sports scores and restaurant picks on the spot
Turns goals into hands-free action plans
slides.voiceover: Meta AI gives hands-free answers, live translation, and local recommendations.

slides.label: Battery
slides.title: All-day audio
slides.sub: Plus 48 more hours from the charging case.
slides.voiceover: The audio glasses run twelve hours, plus forty-eight more from the case.

slides.label: The lineup
slides.title: Dozens of colors, a few specials
items: Kylie Jenner Starfire, LISA, Meta Adventurer at $249
slides.voiceover: There are dozens of color options, plus a Kylie Jenner special edition.

slides.label: Before you buy
slides.title: Availability & fine print
items: Live now in Singapore, South Korea, Mexico and the UAE
More countries, including Turkey, rolling out later this year
Prices start at $249 for the Adventurer style
slides.cta: Follow for daily AI tool news
slides.voiceover: It's rolling out country by country, with prices starting at $249.
